source_summary: Tall ink-and-wash Chinese landscape with the upper portion occupied by inscriptions and seals, and the reusable landscape material concentrated from the middle downward: misty mountains, rocky pine-covered cliffs, river/water expanses, distant shore groves, traveling figures, and foreground rocks and trees.

motifs.name: upper_left_pine_cliffs
motifs.description: A cluster of steep pale rock faces at the upper left-middle, capped and edged with dense dark ink pines and scrub, with vertical cliff washes and broken contour strokes isolated from the surrounding inscriptions and distant shore.
must_preserve: bold dark pine masses on cliff tops
pale vertical rock faces with dry-brush texture
broken ink outlines and fissure strokes
soft wash transitions at the cliff bases
small dark shrubs at the lower rocks

motifs.name: misty_right_mountain_band
motifs.description: Distant grey mountains and horizontal river/mist bands to the right of the upper cliffs, including soft triangular peaks fading into pale wash and thin level waterlines.
must_preserve: thin horizontal water or mist lines
subtle peak contours without hard outlines

motifs.name: riverside_pavilion_grove
motifs.description: Small dark riverside pavilion or hut cluster nestled among heavy trees on the right side below the distant mountains, with compact roof geometry and surrounding ink foliage.
must_preserve: tiny structural linework beneath the eaves

motifs.name: midwater_tree_islet
motifs.description: Small low islet or rock with clustered dark trees in the open water below the upper cliffs, separated from larger landforms.
must_preserve: low pale rock or bank shape

motifs.name: distant_pine_spit
motifs.description: Long low peninsula in the middle distance with a row of slender pines and dotted shoreline texture, projecting across the river from left toward the right.

motifs.name: travelers_with_mount
motifs.description: Two traveling figures in the lower middle: a robed rider on a dark donkey or horse and a walking attendant carrying a long pole or bundle, isolated with the small ground strokes beneath them.
must_preserve: fine contour linework of robes and hats
dark compact animal body and legs
attendant with long diagonal carrying pole
minimal ground line and small hoof/foot marks

motifs.name: foreground_tall_tree_screen
motifs.description: Tall foreground trees rising along the right-center edge, including a dark central conifer and paler vertical trunks behind it, with layered foliage washes.
must_preserve: long straight trunks in pale and dark ink
small dotted ground accents at the roots

motifs.name: foreground_rocky_bank
motifs.description: Large foreground rocky bank at the lower right with heavy dark shrubs, pale rounded rock faces, and textured washes forming the nearest shore.
must_preserve: dark ink shrub masses on ledges
soft wash at the water edge
irregular contour lines and pooled ink shadows

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
